small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 33%: split the (BLOCK_OC=32, BLOCK_SPATIAL=64) tile into smaller variants via @triton.autotune ({BLOCK_OC:16, BLOCK_SPATIAL:64}, {32,32}, {16,128}) and cap registers with maxnreg or num_warps=8 so the per-thread register count drops from 128. Also hoist the inner IC loop's invariant index math (id_idx*IH*IW + ih_idx*IW + iw_idx, and oc-stride for w_off) out of the kd/kh/kw loops, and fuse the BN scale/shift + spatial-mean subtraction epilogue directly into the conv-transpose kernel to eliminate the cudnn BN + reduce + sub kernels (currently 17% of runtime).
large_guidance: Rewrite as a gather-style implicit GEMM keyed on the output grid: one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), with the K dimension being IC*KD*KH*KW; precompute per-K offsets and validity masks (input index + valid bit per (kd,kh,kw)) once per program, then do a real tl.dot over BLOCK_M(OC) x BLOCK_K x BLOCK_N(spatial) tiles in channels_last layout so input loads coalesce on IC. Use autotune tiles like (BM=32,BN=64,BK=16) and (64,32,16) at num_warps=4, num_stages=2 (fits ~80KB SMEM). Fuse the BN affine (folded from running stats) and spatial-mean subtraction into the epilogue: compute per-(N,OC) partial sum during the GEMM store via atomics or a second persistent pass, then subtract in one fused kernel so BN and mean kernels disappear entirely.
